Engine: 18:27 شي قريب = شي غريب, 18:34 'صار my مبارة' = صار معي مبارح, 1:03:22 kana = kamaan likely. No echo-candidates file for 10-27. Proper names (Mahdi, برن) not glossed. medi_turns = 232 Arabic-script Medi lines + ~58 Latin-Arabic ones.

Hidden-Arabic stretches ([يتحدث العربية]) at 36:49-42:15 and 44-47 are not readable; the conjugation drills of the verb بقلق/بقلأ (43:56-47:20) show dropped ق (S4, skipped). Skipped as engine/S4: شي قريب/مبارة 18:27 (غريب, البارحة), أولي/ألهت 47:59-49:30 (قول dropped ق), سودا vs سودة 07:40. Names: Mahdi, برن (Bern, 16:20), Utah (58:04) not counted. 52:22 'he told us' for قلنا left out as unclear. No echo-candidates file for this date.

r3_note: Echo: 54:43 'بتقدر이' = بتقدري (engine wrote Korean 이 for -i). D9/D10 are two separate pieces of one 24:36-25:33 moment (إلك + شوية فترة). فاتحة at 21:06/23:36 is the engine for فترة. Long Latin-transliterated stretches 02:44-03:15, 13:00-17:41, 31:47-36:09, 1:01:41-1:04:23. Names: Mahdi (ماكس at 09:51); برن at 16:20 is the verb 'to call' in that line, not the place.
